With t AS
(
SELECT
    QRY_PURGE.EffDate,
    DATEDIFF(DAY, QRY_PURGE.settlement_dt, QRY_PURGE.EffDate) AS [Days Aged],
    QRY_PURGE.client_nbr,
    QRY_PURGE.instr_spcl_cage_cd,
    QRY_PURGE.ACCOUNT,
    QRY_PURGE.TAG,
    QRY_PURGE.security_adp_nbr,
    QRY_PURGE.cusip_nbr,
    QRY_PURGE.iso_currency_cd,
    CAST(QRY_PURGE.FAIL_QTY as money) as FAIL_QTY,
    QRY_PURGE.FAIL_AMT,
    QRY_PURGE.settlement_dt,
    QRY_PURGE.company_cd,
    QRY_PURGE.oracle_acct_nbr,
    QRY_PURGE.account_unit_cd,
    QRY_PURGE.branch_cd
FROM
    dbo.tbl_Broadridge_COD_Recon_QRY_PURGE QRY_PURGE
    LEFT JOIN dbo.tbl_Broadridge_COD_Recon_Money_Pairoffs MONEY_PAIROFFS ON 
        QRY_PURGE.instr_spcl_cage_cd = MONEY_PAIROFFS.instr_spcl_cage_cd AND
        QRY_PURGE.settlement_dt = MONEY_PAIROFFS.settlement_dt AND
        QRY_PURGE.FAIL_AMT = MONEY_PAIROFFS.FAIL_AMT AND
        CAST(QRY_PURGE.FAIL_QTY as money) = MONEY_PAIROFFS.FAIL_QTY AND
        QRY_PURGE.TAG = MONEY_PAIROFFS.TAG AND
        QRY_PURGE.iso_currency_cd = MONEY_PAIROFFS.iso_currency_cd AND
        QRY_PURGE.security_adp_nbr = MONEY_PAIROFFS.security_adp_nbr AND
        QRY_PURGE.ACCOUNT = MONEY_PAIROFFS.ACCOUNT AND
        QRY_PURGE.client_nbr = MONEY_PAIROFFS.client_nbr AND
        QRY_PURGE.EffDate = MONEY_PAIROFFS.EffDate
WHERE
    CAST(QRY_PURGE.FAIL_QTY as money) <> 0 AND
    MONEY_PAIROFFS.ACCOUNT IS NULL
)

INSERT INTO dbo.tbl_Broadridge_COD_Recon_Adjustment
    SELECT t.instr_spcl_cage_cd,
    t.client_nbr,
    t.ACCOUNT,
    t.iso_currency_cd,
    t.security_adp_nbr,
    t.cusip_nbr,
    -1 * CAST([FAIL_QTY] as money) AS [QTY ADJ],
    -1 * CAST([FAIL_AMT] as money) AS [MONEY ADJ],
    t.company_cd,
    t.oracle_acct_nbr,
    t.account_unit_cd,
    t.TAG,
    t.settlement_dt,
    t.branch_cd

FROM
    t;

USE [ReconControl]
GO

UPDATE [dbo].[tbl_Broadridge_COD_Recon_Adjustment]
SET
    [dbo].[tbl_Broadridge_COD_Recon_Adjustment].oracle_acct_nbr = c.oracle_acct_nbr,
    [dbo].[tbl_Broadridge_COD_Recon_Adjustment].instr_spcl_cage_cd = 'COR'
FROM [dbo].[tbl_Broadridge_COD_Recon_Adjustment] t
INNER JOIN [dbo].[tbl_Broadridge_COD_Recon_CAAU] c
    ON t.client_nbr = c.client_nbr
    AND t.branch_cd = c.branch_cd
WHERE
    (t.oracle_acct_nbr IS NULL OR t.oracle_acct_nbr = '')
    AND t.[MONEY ADJ] > 0
    AND t.company_cd IS NOT NULL
    AND (t.company_cd <> '' OR t.company_cd IS NOT NULL)
    AND c.instr_spcl_cage_cd = 'COR';

UPDATE [dbo].[tbl_Broadridge_COD_Recon_Adjustment]
SET 
    [dbo].[tbl_Broadridge_COD_Recon_Adjustment].oracle_acct_nbr = c.oracle_acct_nbr,
    [dbo].[tbl_Broadridge_COD_Recon_Adjustment].instr_spcl_cage_cd = 'COD'
FROM [dbo].[tbl_Broadridge_COD_Recon_Adjustment] t
INNER JOIN [dbo].[tbl_Broadridge_COD_Recon_CAAU] c
    ON t.branch_cd = c.branch_cd
    AND t.client_nbr = c.client_nbr
WHERE 
    t.oracle_acct_nbr IS NULL
    AND t.[MONEY ADJ] < 0
    AND c.instr_spcl_cage_cd = 'COD'
    AND t.company_cd IS NOT NULL
    AND t.company_cd <> '';
